about.title: Who We Are
about.description: Maroko Ekspert is led by El Ouafi, a seasoned professional with over 15 years of experience in travel and tourism between Morocco and Poland. With a deep understanding of both cultures, El Ouafi specializes in creating authentic and memorable travel experiences. His expertise ensures that each tour is carefully crafted to showcase the best of Moroccan heritage, cuisine, and hospitality.

cities.title: Explore Iconic Moroccan Destinations
cities.subtitle: From ancient imperial medinas to serene coastal towns and golden Sahara dunes.

marrakech.title: Marrakech
marrakech.subtitle: The Imperial Pearl
marrakech.desc: Uncover sensory magic in Jemaa el-Fnaa, luxury riads, vibrant souks, and lush tropical gardens tucked within red earthen walls.

chefchaouen.title: Chefchaouen
chefchaouen.subtitle: The Blue Pearl
chefchaouen.desc: Wander through dreamy indigo-washed alleyways tucked quietly into the dramatic Rif mountains.

fes.title: Fes
fes.subtitle: Spiritual Capital
fes.desc: Journey back in time through Fes el-Bali, the world's largest car-free urban sanctuary and cultural heart of Morocco.

agadir.title: Agadir
agadir.subtitle: Sunshine & Coast
agadir.desc: Bask in year-round sunshine along crescent bay beaches, vibrant promenades, and world-class surfing along the Atlantic coast.

rabat.title: Rabat
rabat.subtitle: The Capital City
rabat.desc: Discover refined royal heritage, the picturesque Kasbah of the Udayas, and modern avant-garde architecture.

ouarzazate.title: Ouarzazate & Ait Ben Haddou
ouarzazate.subtitle: Doorway to the Sahara
ouarzazate.desc: Explore iconic UNESCO earthen fortresses, dramatic desert valleys, and legendary cinematic film locations.

tangier.title: Tangier
tangier.subtitle: Gateway to Africa
tangier.tagline: Where the Mediterranean Meets the Atlantic
tangier.desc: Experience legendary bohemian allure, cliffside cafes, historical medina vistas, and sweeping sea views.

intro.title: 1. Introduction
intro.content: At Maroko Ekspert, we respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. This privacy policy informs you about how we handle your personal information when you visit our website, use our services, or inquire about our tours.

dataCollection.title: 2. Data We Collect
dataCollection.content: We may collect, use, store, and transfer different kinds of personal data about you, including:
items: Inquiry & Booking Data (travel preferences, itinerary details)
Technical Data (IP address, browser type, cookies)

dataUsage.title: 3. How We Use Your Data
dataUsage.content: We use your personal data only when the law allows us to. Most commonly, we process your information to organize travel itineraries, respond to inquiries, send booking confirmations, and improve our services.

thirdParties.title: 4. Third-Party Sharing
thirdParties.content: We do not sell your personal data. We may share necessary details with trusted local partners in Morocco (such as hotels or local transport providers) solely to fulfill your requested tour bookings.

cookies.title: 5. Security & Verification
cookies.content: We implement robust security measures to protect your personal information. Forms on our website are protected by Cloudflare Turnstile to prevent spam and automated abuse without tracking your personal browsing habits.

rights.title: 6. Your Legal Rights
rights.content: Under data protection laws, you have the right to request access, correction, or erasure of your personal data. You may also request to restrict or object to the processing of your data at any time.

contact.title: 7. Contact Us
contact.content: If you have any questions regarding this Privacy Policy or wish to exercise your legal rights, please reach out to us at biuro@maroko-ekspert.pl.

intro.title: 1. Agreement to Terms
intro.content: By accessing or using the services provided by Maroko Ekspert, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree to all of these terms, please do not use our website or services.

services.title: 2. Tour Services & Bookings
services.content: Maroko Ekspert specializes in organizing guided tours, excursions, and custom travel itineraries across Morocco. A booking is considered confirmed once written confirmation and any required deposit have been received.

payments.title: 3. Payments & Cancellations
payments.content: Payment schedules and cancellation policies will be outlined in your personal itinerary quote. Cancellations made within the agreed notification window are eligible for refunds minus non-refundable operational costs (e.g., hotel reservations or advance permits).

responsibilities.title: 4. Traveler Responsibilities
responsibilities.content: Travelers are responsible for ensuring they hold valid passports, visas, and appropriate travel insurance prior to departure. Maroko Ekspert is not liable for delays or expenses caused by missing travel documentation.
items: Compliance with local Moroccan laws and customs

alterations.title: 5. Itinerary Alterations & Force Majeure
alterations.content: While we strive to adhere strictly to planned schedules, Maroko Ekspert reserves the right to alter itineraries in response to unforeseen events, weather conditions, or safety concerns. We are not liable for delays caused by circumstances beyond our control (force majeure).

intellectualProperty.title: 6. Intellectual Property
intellectualProperty.content: All content on this website, including text, logos, imagery, and tour itineraries, is the intellectual property of Maroko Ekspert and protected under applicable copyright laws.

contact.title: 7. Questions & Support
contact.content: If you have any questions regarding these Terms of Service, please contact us directly at biuro@maroko-ekspert.pl.
